experiment: Symmetric (n=15000 vs n=15000) held-out vs train-sampled RF generalisation gap
question: The earlier held-out-vs-train comparison used mismatched sample sizes (n=999 or n=15000 held-out vs n=999 train-sampled). This repeats it at matched n=15000 on both sides for a fully symmetric significance test.

accuracy_gap.method: percentile bootstrap on the difference between two independently-resampled samples (not a paired/McNemar comparison -- a and b are different alerts)
accuracy_gap.interpretation: metric(a)-metric(b) = -0.0359, 95% CI [-0.0461, -0.0257]. This excludes 0, so the gap is a real effect at this sample size, not sampling noise.
